intro: Expenses you have claimed back, and anything you are repaying through your salary.
reimbursementsIntro: Money you spent on work that the institute pays back. Approved claims are paid out with a future month's salary.
emptyClaimsDescription: Claim a work expense back and it appears here with its status, from Pending through to paid.
loansInfo: Loans and salary advances are set up by your HR team — there is nothing to apply for here. Each month's EMI is deducted from your salary automatically until the balance reaches zero.
emptyLoansTitle: You have no loans or advances
emptyLoansDescription: Nothing is being deducted from your salary for repayment. If your HR team sets up a loan, it appears here.
